question: At which temporal part is Śākeśvarī not manifested and at which is she manifested?
premises: At the end Śākeśvarī is not manifested.
She is manifested in the middle part.
The manifestation depends on the time division.
inference: Śākeśvarī is not manifested at the end but is manifested in the middle part.
plain_english: At the end Śākeśvarī is not manifested; she is manifested in the middle part.
